UMAP embedding

Source: R/talos_embedding.R
TALOS_run_umap.Rd

Computes a 2-dimensional UMAP embedding from a reduced-dimension representation. Defaults to PCA; pass use_rep = "scVI" to embed from the scVI latent space produced by TALOS_run_scvi. Results are stored in reducedDims(sce)[["UMAP"]].

Usage

TALOS_run_umap(
  sce,
  use_rep = "PCA",
  n_pcs = 30L,
  n_neighbors = 15L,
  min_dist = 0.1,
  use_graph = TRUE,
  seed = 42L,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

sce

A SingleCellExperiment with the chosen reduced dimension already populated.

use_rep

Character. Name of the reducedDims slot to use as input. Default "PCA". Use "scVI" for the batch-corrected latent embedding from TALOS_run_scvi.

n_pcs

Integer. Number of PCA components to use when use_rep = "PCA". Ignored for other representations (all dims are used). Default 30.

n_neighbors

Integer. Number of nearest neighbours for the UMAP graph. Higher values produce a more global view; lower values emphasise local structure. Default 15.

min_dist

Numeric. Minimum distance between points in the embedding. Smaller values pack points more tightly. Default 0.1.

seed

Integer. Random seed for reproducibility. Default 42L.

verbose

Logical. Print a summary. Default TRUE.

Value

SCE with reducedDims(sce)[["UMAP"]] populated.
